hints.title: Mountain Footprint Intervals
hints.text: A triangular mountain with peak (x, y) covers the base interval [x - y, x + y].

hints.title: Subsumption Condition
hints.text: Mountain A is hidden by mountain B if left(B) <= left(A) and right(A) <= right(B). Duplicate identical mountains hide each other.

hints.title: Interval Sorting
hints.text: Group identical peaks and sort distinct intervals by left boundary ascending, and right boundary descending for ties.

hints.title: Sorted Interval Sweep Implementation

complexity.notes: Grouping duplicate peaks and sorting intervals.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Pairwise comparison of all mountain intervals costs O(n^2).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Counter and intervals list take linear auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Maps 2D isosceles mountain triangles to 1D interval containment and sweeps sorted boundaries.
